purpose: Automatically accept a future mounted Lean4Lean source archive, extract it to a stable intake directory, and run the KA-7 strict actual import gate without changing PSKernel trusted semantics.
strictAcceptanceCriteria: A mounted Lean4Lean source tree or archive is discovered.
Archive extraction produces a tree containing the required Lean4Lean source files.
The candidate lean-toolchain targets leanprover/lean4:v4.33.1 unless a separate compatibility override is created later.
KA-7 strict actual import gate passes against the intake candidate.
No PSKernel trusted-kernel semantics, codec, or computation rule is changed.
